answer: Because the timing is logged against the meadow challenge, the cedar audit can replay the pigment history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 37 submissions and hold each account open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 56 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
